gitCommit.subject: Sprint 22 demo summary
gitCommit.body:
Sprint 22 demo summary

From the CI and staging runs of 726d754: 17 cases passed in the browser, 6 checked in CI, none failed, none by hand.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WPpy6XYfi9BKBXrsw4t5HH

specs.title: Home, as an admin

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Everyone lands on Home: what needs you, your responses, what we know
For admins: the answers waiting for review, as one line
It opens Knowledge, All answers, with those answers filtered

specs.title: A question for the member, sent to the owner, and the owner uses their answer

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "Do you give staff paid volunteering days each year?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
Tom Richardson lands on Home: the question is waiting for them
Assignments opens on that question, with everything needed to answer it
Notes for the owner
The answer, sent to the owner to decide
Sarah Chen sees it on Home, under Answered by colleagues
It opens the response at that question, still to do, with their answer and Use their answer

specs.title: Hand back, with a note

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "What compliance certifications does your organization hold?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
The question has a draft, its confidence and checker, and the answers it was drawn from
Tom Richardson is not the right person: Hand back, with a reason of at least 5 characters
Sarah Chen sees it handed back, on Home and on the question
The answers it was drawn from open on their own page under Knowledge

specs.title: Approve, and when the owner was quicker

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "What endpoint protection solutions are deployed?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
Meanwhile Sarah Chen approves the same question
Tom Richardson, on the screen opened before, presses Approve: nothing is overwritten
A question nobody else is deciding: Tom Richardson writes the answer and approves it
Sarah Chen assigns "フィッシング攻撃をどのように検知し、対応していますか？" to Tom Richardson

specs.title: On a phone, and the Sent list

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Sarah Chen assigns "What is the annual subscription price for 250 users?" to Tom Richardson
Tom Richardson signs in
At phone width Home stacks and nothing scrolls sideways
Assignments stacks too: the list, then the question
Sent lists the questions you assigned, with their stages, and no buttons to move them on by hand

specs.title: A member who was not assigned cannot see or decide the question

steps.title: Maya Patel signs in
Maya was assigned nothing on Bluefin: Home does not list it, and the card has no decision buttons

specs.title: Ask it a question: the real pipeline on staging, the fallback locally

annotations.description: Locally the providers are off: calls 0 before, 0 after, not compared

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Before asking: the calls recorded as Asking the knowledge base this month
The same question with every AI provider switched off: the fallback answer
After asking: the ask is recorded under Spend by use

annotations.description: Locally the providers are off: calls 0 before, 0 after, not compared

specs.title: Nothing to download or mark as sent while questions are still to do

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Bluefin still has questions to do: no download, no Mark as sent, and the reason

specs.title: A member who does not own the response sees neither Download nor Mark as sent

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Tom Richardson signs in
Tom Richardson opens Larkspur, which they do not own

specs.title: Changed since sent, download, the confirmation, and marking as sent again

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Larkspur was sent: the stage reads Sent, with the date
Sarah Chen assigns a question to Tom Richardson, then edits two answers
The pricing question, left unanswered before, now gets an answer written by a person
A change after sending: the stage reads Changed since sent
Downloading does not mark it as sent
Mark as sent says first what it will do; Cancel changes nothing
Confirmed: Sent again, the assignment closed, and what the knowledge base learned
The audit log records who marked it as sent, and when

specs.title: Gaps: what the knowledge base could not answer, where each stands, and one step to act

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
First, one question the knowledge base could not answer is left unanswered
Knowledge counts the gaps not answered yet, beside the other states
Every state, with how many responses asked each question
A learned gap opens the answer it became
One not answered yet opens in its response, at that question

specs.title: Gaps show a question's markup as text

steps.title: Tom Richardson signs in
A question containing markup shows as the text it is

specs.title: Plain settings first, the tuning under Advanced, and spend by use

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
What an admin changes most often is in view: the budget, the warning point and the daily limits
Advanced holds the reserves, the exchange rate, the prices and the spend by model
Saving from either part works, and each save is in the audit log

specs.title: The audit log by person and by response, with the kind, together

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
One person: only what they did
One response: what happened to it, its files and its questions
All three together: marked as sent, by this admin, on this response

specs.title: The audit log says when more entries match than it shows

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
When more than 200 match, the log says so, and how to see older ones

specs.title: Someone whose account was deleted is a former user in the person filter and the rows

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
A person whose account was deleted shows as a former user

specs.title: Names with markup show as text in the audit log's filters and rows

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
A name containing markup shows as the text it is, in the filters and in the log

specs.title: The header says where the response stands, as its card on Responses does; every question in one group

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Bluefin on Responses: its stage, due date and progress
The response opens with its header: owner, due date, progress, stage, files and the three stages
Every question is in one group, and the groups add up to the header's count

specs.title: A question that needs a person says why, first; Ready to approve holds the rest

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Needs a person: one reason on each, first
Ready to approve: nothing holds these, so they carry no reason

specs.title: With experts: every question asked of a colleague, an answer first; choosing one opens it

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
With experts: who was asked, where each stands, and their note
Choosing one opens it at its question

specs.title: A member who does not own the response sees where it stands, and no approval, assignment or send control

steps.title: Tom Richardson signs in
Tom Richardson sees the header, the groups and the reasons

specs.title: An archived response shows the same page, read-only

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
An archived response: the same header and groups, with nothing to change

specs.title: At phone width the header, the stages and the groups fit

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
At phone width: the header, the stages and the groups, with no sideways scrolling

specs.title: A question or file name containing markup shows as text

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
A question and a file name containing markup show as the text they are

specs.title: A response with two files lists both in the header; choosing the other opens it

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
A second file for the same response
Choosing the other file opens it

specs.title: Bulk approval takes only Ready to approve, and the groups update

steps.title: Sarah Chen signs in
Approve in bulk at 80% or more: 2 ready to approve, 3 needing a person
Only Ready to approve was taken: Needs a person is unchanged
